name: Mister A's
menu_notes: Compared against current asrestaurant.com dinner-menu and weekend-brunch-menu pages. Our menu blends dinner and brunch dishes under sections (To Start/Hot/To Follow/Eggs/Sweets) that don't match either real menu's structure. Matched dishes (Red Top Pork Belly, House Ground Prime Burger, Duroc Pork Chop, The American, Wild Alaskan Halibut, Jumbo Shrimp Cocktail) are correct within $1-2. Several dishes are gone from both current menus entirely: Golden Beet Carpaccio, Local Fig Flatbread, Maine Lobster Sliders, Wild Oregon Coast Sole Almondine, Jidori Chicken Marsala, Bluefin Tuna Crudo Niçoise, Prime Steak Frites, Butterscotch Budino. Prices generally run $2-$15 below current (e.g. Georges Bank Scallops $39.5 vs real $54.50), consistent with the third-party source_url (menutoeat.com) being an old snapshot.
data_notes: Address confirmed exact (2550 Fifth Ave, 12th Floor, San Diego, CA 92103, Manchester Financial Building) and Bankers Hill neighborhood is correct. Restaurant is open/operating (OpenTable reservations live). Cuisine 'American' is a reasonable simplification of the site's own 'New American'. Hours issue: our stored dinner-window end times (10-11pm) actually match the site's listed BAR hours, not the kitchen's real dinner service which closes at 8:30-8:45pm; lunch/brunch windows (Wed-Fri 11-1, Sat 10-1, Sun 10-1:30) match correctly.
issues: Menu mixes stale dinner+brunch items under section labels that don't correspond to either real menu
8-9 dishes (~30% of 29) no longer appear on either current menu at all
Most surviving dishes are priced $2-$15 below current menu prices
Stored closing times reflect bar hours, not the earlier kitchen/dinner-service close time
